notes: • D&D 5e sheet tabs: the header and the tabs could not be clicked. With the tab row on and the sheet in the system's dark theme, nothing in a character's header answered a click: not the name, the rest buttons, Inspiration, nor the tabs in the row themselves. In that theme the system lays the character's banner over the top of the sheet as a layer of its own, and it was being drawn on top of them and took the clicks. The row is now moved to its place after the header instead of being reordered there, which is what had put the banner in front. Sheets in the light theme, and any sheet with the setting off, were not affected.
